# Checkbox

```ts
import { Checkbox } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

An independent on/off control — each checkbox stands alone, so any number can be checked at once. Use it for multi-select lists, "accept the terms" gating, and boolean settings that are saved with a form. For one choice from a set use Radio; for a single setting that applies instantly use Switch.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` | `boolean \| 'indeterminate'` | — | Controlled state. true / false, or 'indeterminate' for a partial selection (e.g. a "select all" that only some children satisfy). Pair with onCheckedChange. |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | `false` | Initial state for uncontrolled usage. Ignored when checked is provided. |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean \| 'indeterminate') => void` | — | Fired with the next state whenever the user toggles. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the checkbox. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field required in a form. |
| `label` | `string` | — | Visible text label, wired via <label htmlFor> so clicking it toggles. When omitted, pass aria-label to keep an accessible name. |
| `name` | `string` | — | Accessible name for a labelless checkbox. Required when label is omitted. */ 'aria-label'?: string; /** Form field name submitted with the value. |
| `value` | `string` | `'on'` | Form value submitted when checked. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Explicit id (auto-generated when omitted). |


## Usage

```tsx
<Checkbox label="Subscribe to updates" />
<Checkbox label="Selected" defaultChecked />
<Checkbox label="Accept terms" checked={ok} onCheckedChange={setOk} />
<Checkbox label="Select all" checked="indeterminate" onCheckedChange={…} />
<Checkbox label="Unavailable" disabled />
<Checkbox aria-label="Row 3" />
```

## Accessibility

- Radix provides role="checkbox", aria-checked ("mixed" when indeterminate), and Space to toggle — don't re-implement any of it.
- The visible label is wired via <label htmlFor>, so clicking the text toggles the box. A labelless checkbox must pass aria-label.
- The check/dash marks are aria-hidden — the state is conveyed by aria-checked, not the glyph.
- The focus ring is drawn on :focus-visible and never removed.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use for independent, multi-select options. | Use for one-of-many — that's Radio. |
| Reserve indeterminate for a parent "select all". | Set indeterminate as a normal user-selectable state. |
| Give every box a label or aria-label. | Ship an unlabeled checkbox. |
| Use for settings saved on submit. | Use for a setting that applies instantly — that's Switch. |
